resources.string: Connect your YUNMAI YMBS-M263 scale and save weight to Health Connect for Google Fit or Google Health.

1. Install Google Fit or Google Health.
2. Allow ScaleMate to write weight to Health Connect.
3. In your Google app, connect Health Connect and allow reading weight.

ScaleMate needs no account. Writes happen locally; display in your Google app may be delayed.
Step briefly on your scale to wake it, then keep your phone nearby. Only M263-compatible packets appear here.
No compatible scales found. Wake the scale and try again.
Check that the label on this scale says YMBS-M263. It broadcasts weight and needs no system pairing.
Step off, then onto the scale to start a new weigh-in
Weight is stable · check your scale display
Saved locally · check writing status in Records
The reading is no longer fresh
First verify the reading. Automatic confirmation remains off for unverified scales.
Scale reading verified. You can enable automatic confirmation in Settings.
Keep this screen open while weighing. Leaving or locking cancels the pending reading.
Your confirmed weigh-ins will appear here.
Delete local and Health Connect record
Only this app’s record is affected. Data already imported by a Google app may need deleting there too.
After a verified scale reports steady readings, save in 5 seconds unless cancelled. Only use for your own weigh-ins. Stability thresholds still need real-scale testing.

ScaleMate scans your chosen scale only while this app is open. Confirmed weights and device names are stored locally. With your permission, weight and measurement time are written to Health Connect. No account, server, location tracking or analytics are used. You can revoke permissions, unbind scales and delete this app’s records. Other health apps control their own imports.
Bluetooth is unavailable or permission was denied. Enable Bluetooth and allow Nearby devices, then retry.
Scale data could not be verified. Please weigh again.
Local save failed. Please retry; no new health write was started.
Scan timed out. Please wake the scale and retry.
No fresh weight data. Please weigh again.
Could not open this screen. Please check your system settings.
Weight permission was not granted. You can still save locally.
